name: Duplicate Transaction ID Fix
summary: Fixed a critical vulnerability where multiple transactions could share the same txid, which could be combined with a merkle tree quirk to break consensus between nodes (CVE-2012-2459).
summaryZh: 修复了一个关键漏洞：多个交易可能共享相同的交易ID，这可能与默克尔树的特殊结构结合，破坏节点间的共识（CVE-2012-2459）。
